topic: React Components, Props, State, and Event Handling
learningObjectives: Differentiate props and state in React components.
Pass data between components using props.
Manage interactive UI behavior using state and events.

activities.title: Props vs State
activities.instruction: Choose which React concept best describes each data scenario.

content.concept: Props are values passed into a component by its parent, while state is data managed by a component that can change over time.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: A parent passes a username to a child component → Props
A counter changes after the user clicks a button → State
config.answer: A parent passes a username to a child component → Props

activities.title: One-Way Data Flow Explorer
activities.instruction: Click each component to trace how props move through the component tree.

content.concept: React commonly uses one-way data flow, where data is passed from parent components to child components through props.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Owns or receives the data that needs to be passed down.
Carries values from the parent to the child component.
Receives props and uses them while rendering its interface.
The visible result produced by the component.

activities.title: State Update Explorer
activities.instruction: Change the state value and observe how the UI value changes.

content.concept: Updating state with its setter function causes React to render the component again using the new state value.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Interactive Component Builder
activities.instruction: Build the flow of an interactive React component.

content.concept: An interactive component receives props, stores changing values in state, responds to events, and renders the updated interface.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
